definition: A mutex (mutual exclusion object) is a program object that allows multiple program threads to share the same resource, such as file access, but not simultaneously.
details: A mutex (mutual exclusion object) is a program object that allows multiple program threads to share the same resource, such as file access, but not simultaneously. When a program is locked by a mutex, no other thread can access the locked region of code until the mutex is unlocked.
